name: HYDRA-UMC-SERVER
notes: The real headless backend every control client (STUDIO, SUITE, DSI, the mobile apps) actually talks to. It relays bounded authenticated voice turns to a loopback HYDRA-UMC-VOICE-UI gateway while retaining the gateway token server-side (voice never becomes a direct robot command), and now relays the real CM5<->STM32H745 SPI-OTA link to a local spi_bridge service (admin-only for flashing, live progress over WebSocket) - not yet exercised against real STM32H745 hardware, since no populated board exists yet.
